answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments hash each thread of prior behavior into a succinct proof, while a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function bounds horizon of fresh proof generation. Staking collateral ties identity to economic mass, and slashing penalties yield negative expected attack utility against identity cloning, since forging a proof at zenith of delay requires infeasible sequential work. Thus Sybil creation strictly fails information-theoretically and reaches a robust Nash equilibrium with BFT finality.
